title: SPRI Bead Purification and Size Selection Protocol
author: Opentrons
materials: Beads are incubated for specified amount of time

steps.title: Mix beads in reservoir
steps.instruction: Vortex or pipette‑mix the SPRI bead suspension in the reservoir until a uniform dispersion is achieved.

steps.title: Add calculated bead volume
steps.instruction: For each sample, calculate the first bead volume as (Initial Sample Volume µL × Bead Ratio 1) and dispense that volume of beads into the well; mix thoroughly to resuspend the sample.

steps.title: Incubate bead binding
steps.instruction: Allow the bead‑sample mixture to incubate for the Bead Incubation Time (default 5 min).

steps.title: Engage magnetic module
steps.instruction: Place the plate on the magnetic module and engage it for the Bead Separation Time (parameter defined by the protocol).

steps.title: Remove supernatant
steps.instruction: Using a pipette, remove the supernatant from each well. If performing a single‑step purification, discard to waste; if performing size selection, transfer the supernatant to the second magnetic module plate.

steps.title: Add second bead volume (size selection)
steps.instruction: When size selection is required, calculate the second bead volume as (Transfer Volume µL × Bead Ratio 2) and add this volume to the transferred supernatant on the second magnetic module; mix well.

steps.title: Incubate second bead binding
steps.instruction: Incubate the second bead‑supernatant mixture for the Bead Incubation Time (default 5 min).

steps.title: Engage magnetic module (second)
steps.instruction: Engage the magnetic module on the second plate for the Bead Separation Time.

steps.title: Remove second supernatant
steps.instruction: Discard the supernatant from the second plate to liquid waste.

steps.title: First ethanol wash
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL of ethanol to each well (reuse tips and dispense from the top), briefly mix, re‑engage the magnetic module for the Bead Separation Time, then remove and discard the ethanol supernatant to waste.

substeps.instruction: Add 200 µL ethanol (top dispense, tip reuse)
Engage magnet, wait for bead separation

steps.title: Second ethanol wash
steps.instruction: Repeat the ethanol wash: add another 200 µL ethanol, mix, separate beads on the magnet, and discard the supernatant.

substeps.instruction: Add 200 µL ethanol (top dispense, tip reuse)
Engage magnet, wait for bead separation

steps.title: Air‑dry beads
steps.instruction: Leave the beads exposed to air for the Bead Air Dry Time (default 10 min) to evaporate residual ethanol.

steps.title: Add elution liquid
steps.instruction: Dispense the specified volume of elution buffer (or water) onto the dried beads and mix to resuspend.

steps.title: Mix and incubate eluate
steps.instruction: Mix the elution mixture and incubate for the specified elution incubation time (as defined in the protocol).

steps.title: Separate beads and collect eluate
steps.instruction: Engage the magnetic module for the Bead Separation Time, wait for beads to collect, then transfer the clear supernatant (the eluted sample) to the awaiting plate located in slot 3.
